item.text: The current hasher stores random `maphash.Seed` values per ID, which cannot be recreated from a supplied string. I’m changing it to store string seeds and use the existing global hash seed when computing each result.

`SetSeed` is now available on both the global hasher and `Hasher` instances. I also added tests for reseeding, restoring a seed, and keeping IDs independent. I’ll format the code and run the package tests now.

item.text:
Added `Hasher.SetSeed` and the package-level `SetSeed` in [hasher.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher.go). Each ID now keeps a string seed, so restoring a previous seed restores its hash results. Missing IDs still receive a seed automatically, and map access is synchronized.

Added coverage in [hasher_test.go](/app/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go). The package tests and race tests pass.
